purpose: Evidence for the project owner to sign off, or not, on nine candidate events for Milestone 2 step 3 (batch 3 of 7, the next candidates of the 44 that remained after batches 1-2). Nothing here is an acceptance: each event stays quarantined, and no label is computed, until the corresponding attestations are added.
how_candidates_were_chosen: Batch 3 is the next 11 candidates by filing date after batches 1-2 (OKTA 2024-12-03 through REAL 2025-02-20). Two of the 11 are excluded as not qualifying earnings events (reports/m2-step3-batch3-eligibility-review-2026-10-02.json) -- OKTA's 2025-02-04 filing (pure guidance reaffirmation) and REAL's 2025-02-10 filing (explicitly 'preliminary', superseded by this batch's own 2025-02-20 candidate) -- leaving 9 genuine candidates built here.

dry_run.result: All 9 pending events ran with no attestations: every event quarantined on FIRST_PUBLIC_TIME_UNVERIFIED with no labels. All 21 of batches 1-2's already-attested events re-confirmed state MAPPED. CXT shows a second real cash dividend (ex-date 2025-02-28, following the one already accepted for its 2024-11-06 candidate). The other 8 of 9 are clean (empty corporate_actions). A real missing_sessions gap was initially found for love-step3-2024-12-12 (2025-01-09) -- see the calendar correction below; re-ran clean after the fix.

real_calendar_correction: This batch's own dry run surfaced a genuine bug: 2025-01-09 (NYSE/Nasdaq's real, one-time closure for President Carter's National Day of Mourning) was missing from nre/calendar-2025.json, because that file was built from the official yearly calendar PDF, published before the closure was announced. Fixed and scoped before this packet was finalized -- full detail in reports/m2-step3-calendar-2025-01-09-correction-2026-10-02.json. Checked against every already-built event in this project; only love-step3-2024-12-12 (built in this same batch) was affected, and it had not yet been attested when found.

signoff_items_requested.first_public_time_and_historical_identit: Accept the chronology and identity evidence per candidate below. Two candidates (OKTA, REAL) carry a sibling exclusion in this same batch rather than the usual 'none found' gap -- see each one's own entry.
signoff_items_requested.corporate_actions: For 8 of 9 candidates: accept two independent clean signals -- no Item 3.03/5.03 8-K on the event date itself, and Alpaca's real, fully paginated corporate-actions response empty. CXT is the exception -- a second real cash dividend (ex-date 2025-02-28), the same issuer and treatment already accepted for its first step-3 candidate.
